name: laser-tag-spot
description: 8s neon laser tag commercial built with Remotion

scripts.render:reel: remotion render src/index.ts LucioleReel out/luciole-reel-raw.mp4 && npm run master:reel
scripts.master:reel: ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/luciole-reel-raw.mp4 -c:v copy -bsf:v h264_metadata=colour_primaries=1:transfer_characteristics=1:matrix_coefficients=1 -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=9 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -movflags +faststart out/luciole-reel.mp4
scripts.covers:preopening: for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08; do remotion still src/index.ts LucioleCover$n out/covers/luciole-preopening-$n.png || exit 1; done
scripts.covers:softopening: for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08; do remotion still src/index.ts LucioleSoftCover$n out/covers/luciole-softopening-$n.png || exit 1; done
